plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for FiberRoad managed media-converter chassis. It reports chassis temperature in Celsius, fan state, dual PSU on/off state and dual PSU voltage state per shelf, plus uptime and interface traffic, for 2U MC shelves (enterprise PEN 6688).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature of each FiberRoad media-converter shelf in degrees Celsius. Values outside -40 to 125 Celsius are dropped. Absent slave shelves that report nc for every status object are not emitted.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Fan state of each FiberRoad shelf, normalized so on(1) is normal and off(2) is abnormal. nc(3) and any other code are dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power-supply state of each FiberRoad shelf feed A/B, normalized so on(1) is normal and off(2) is abnormal. nc(3) and any other code are dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_voltage_state
metrics.description: Voltage state of each FiberRoad shelf feed A/B, normalized so normal(1) is healthy and abnormal(2) is fault. nc(3) and any other code are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counters.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counters.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the FiberRoad chassis and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
